WITH first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fv.member_id) AS new_members_count
FROM first_version fv
WHERE fv.version_no = 1
  AND fv.join_date = '2026-09-25'

WITH first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT fv.home_store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT fv.member_id) AS new_members
FROM first_version fv
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE fv.version_no = 1
  AND fv.join_date = '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY fv.home_store_id, cs.store_name
ORDER BY new_members DESC
